system.description:
You kindle in another's cold heart a devotion so absolute that it mirrors the surrender of the blood itself; the target gazes upon you with the aching adoration of the thrice-bound, hanging on your every word and desiring nothing so much as your favor.

This power duplicates the effect of a Blood Bond for as long as the target remains in your presence. You must win a Social Challenge for the Discipline to take effect; its hold lapses the moment the target is no longer in your presence.
system.duration: As long as target remains in your presence
